candidates.hypothesis: A failed upside breakout followed by two closes below the level traps late buyers and creates a reversal edge.
candidates.marketMechanism: Failed expansion leaves demand above invalidation while supply controls the reclaim failure.
candidates.entryLogic: Closed failed-breakout frame, lower high, bearish confirmation and bounded next-open entry.
candidates.invalidationLogic: Reclaim of the prior upside breakout level.
candidates.expectedFailureMode: The breakout resumes after a temporary shakeout.

candidates.hypothesis: A support breakdown, bounded retest from below, rejection and continuation confirmation should improve short entry location.
candidates.marketMechanism: Former support becomes overhead supply after trapped longs test the broken level.
candidates.entryLogic: Closed support break, below-level retest, rejection close and lower continuation close.
candidates.invalidationLogic: The broken support is reclaimed on a closed candle.
candidates.expectedFailureMode: Absorption turns the breakdown into a bear trap.

candidates.hypothesis: Compression followed by downside range expansion and participation confirmation can expose a controlled continuation edge.
candidates.marketMechanism: Stored range energy resolves lower when volume and realized volatility expand together.
candidates.entryLogic: Closed compression, downside range expansion below the prior floor, volume and volatility confirmation.
candidates.invalidationLogic: The compression floor is reclaimed after the expansion.
candidates.expectedFailureMode: A one-bar volatility shock mean reverts inside the range.

candidates.hypothesis: In a mature bear trend, a rebound into value followed by a fresh lower-low rejection can offer continuation without shorting the initial impulse.
candidates.marketMechanism: Counter-trend liquidity is absorbed near value before the dominant supply regime resumes.
candidates.entryLogic: Bear alignment, bounded rebound into EMA/value, bearish rejection and fresh lower-low confirmation.
candidates.invalidationLogic: A closed reclaim above the rebound value zone.
candidates.expectedFailureMode: The rebound is a true trend reversal rather than a pullback.

candidates.hypothesis: A bullish trend that sweeps value and reclaims the recent high can provide a distinct LONG continuation edge.
candidates.marketMechanism: A downside liquidity sweep resets positioning before demand reclaims the local range.
candidates.entryLogic: Bull alignment, bounded liquidity sweep, bullish reclaim and next-open execution.
candidates.invalidationLogic: The swept value area is lost on a closed candle.
candidates.expectedFailureMode: The sweep is distribution and the trend has already turned lower.

selectionPolicy: Candidate selection is based on development/inner data. Nested outer OOS is not used to choose the final candidate. No candidate is added after results.
